description: This file provides a shell script implementation for managing IPv6-in-IPv4 tunnels using the 6to4 protocol in a network configuration context. It includes functions for setting up, testing, and tearing down 6to4 tunnels, initializing configurations, and handling related network parameters.

methods.name: find_6to4_prefix
methods.description: Converts an IPv4 address to a 6to4 IPv6 prefix in the format 2002:XXXX:XXXX

methods.name: test_6to4_rfc1918
methods.description: Checks if the given IPv4 address falls within private or special-purpose ranges (RFC 1918 and RFC 6598)

methods.name: proto_6to4_setup
methods.description: Configures and initiates a 6to4 IPv6 tunnel based on provided parameters and network status

methods.name: proto_6to4_teardown
methods.description: Placeholder function to tear down a 6to4 tunnel (currently empty)

methods.name: proto_6to4_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for the 6to4 protocol, specifying required parameters
